messages:
maria: Quick sync — need a tight benchmark narrative for the launch post + a webinar hook. Goal: show how Redwood helps teams cut per-token cost while preserving latency for real-time features. thoughts?

ev an: Two quick chart ideas: 1) cost vs median latency scatter with model families grouped; 2) a small-multiples heatmap showing cost per 1k tokens across sequence lengths and batching profiles. heatmap -> immediate visceral econ story.

sophie: +1 on heatmap. For marketing, split the narrative by persona: startups (cost-first) and platform/enterprise (SLA/latency-first). different lead magnets for each.

maria: good. copy angle attempts: "Cut inference cost, not response speed" or "Predictable latency at lower unit cost" — which lands?

ev an: I like the second for enterprise. For PLG/startup: "Get production-grade inference without the ops bill." Short and sticky.

jordan: On inbound routing: can we tag leads from the webinar as either "cost-interested" or "latency/SLA" based on poll answers? then route to Growth vs Solutions eng for follow-up. Also add a field for "target monthly token volume" in the registration form.

sophie: Poll ideas: include a slider for priority (cost 1-5, latency 1-5) and a checkbox for "planning dedicated capacity". That will help auto-segment.

maria: Love that. For the blog post visuals, propose: top hero = simplified heatmap (bright callout on low-cost / low-latency region), inline chart = scatter showing actual model runs (gives credibility), and an ROI callout with a tiny table: tokens -> $ saved / month.

ev an: Can we add a mini technical note in the appendix: how batching, KV-caching, and quantization shift points on the chart? 1-2 bullets. engineers will love that.

sophie: Yes, and a small "how we ran the benchmark" blurb with reproducible config. Something like: 
```
model: gpt-xx-lite
batch_sizes: [1,4,16]
seq_lengths: [64,256,1024]
quant: int8
env: p100/rtx6000

metric: tokens_per_dollar, median_latency_ms
```

maria: Perfect. timeline wise — need first draft charts + post copy by EOD Tuesday. Webinar date tentative: 2 weeks after publish. Can we get comms + lifecycle emails ready?

jordan: I'll wire up the registration form and tags. Need the exact poll fields by end of day Monday.

ev an: I'll hand off the chart spec to analytics and ask for CSVs with per-run median latencies and cost estimates. Will also prepare 2 alt headline lines for A/B.

sophie: I'll draft persona-specific CTAs for the post and webinar follow-ups. Also a short playbook for SDRs on follow-up sequencing (cost lead -> pricing + benchmarking call; SLA lead -> SRE deep-dive).

maria: Awesome. final checklist: heatmap (marketing-friendly), scatter (credibility), mini bench config, poll fields + reg form, registration tags, webinar landing + comms, SDR playbook. Everyone assignable?

ev an: taking charts + CSVs.

sophie: taking CTAs + playbook.

jordan: taking form + tags.

maria: I'll draft post copy and coordinate design for hero.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Benchmark launch webinar" on 2024-06-18 10:00 PDT — attendees: marketing, growth, analytics, solutions.

ev an: Nice. One last ask — let's include a 1-paragraph "what this means for teams" box in the post: actionable levers (batch, cache, routing) with quick expected percent savings per lever. short bullets.

sophie: I'll write that. Keep numbers conservative (10-30% per lever) unless analytics gives more.

maria: Great — check-in tomorrow morning 9am to review first visuals. Thanks team :rocket:
